description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 4, untapping it.
Repeat.
